name: Four Star General
description: A simple browser-based hex strategy game inspired by Panzer General.
author: Sixsmith Games

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-tsc', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --outDir dist-tsc && xcopy /E /I /Y "src\assets" "dist-tsc\src\assets" && node --loader ./tools/resolve-js-extension-loader.mjs dist-tsc/tests/index.js
scripts.test:jest: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-tsc-jest', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --outDir dist-tsc-jest && xcopy /E /I /Y "src\assets" "dist-tsc-jest\src\assets" && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js
scripts.test:jest:watch: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-tsc-jest', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --outDir dist-tsc-jest && xcopy /E /I /Y "src\assets" "dist-tsc-jest\src\assets" && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --watch
scripts.test:airshow:diagnostics: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-tsc', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --outDir dist-tsc && xcopy /E /I /Y "src\assets" "dist-tsc\src\assets" && node --loader ./tools/resolve-js-extension-loader.mjs dist-tsc/tests/run-airshow-diagnostics.js
scripts.test:airshow:report: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-tsc', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --outDir dist-tsc && xcopy /E /I /Y "src\assets" "dist-tsc\src\assets" && node --loader ./tools/resolve-js-extension-loader.mjs dist-tsc/tests/AirScenario.report.js --fail-on-anomalies
scripts.test:airshow:visual: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-tsc-jest', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --outDir dist-tsc-jest && xcopy /E /I /Y "src\assets" "dist-tsc-jest\src\assets" && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runInBand AirShow.visual.jest.test.js
scripts.test:airshow: npm run test:airshow:diagnostics && npm run test:airshow:report && npm run test:airshow:visual && npm run test:airshow:e2e:visual && npm run test:airshow:e2e:choreography
scripts.report:air-scenario: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-tsc', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --outDir dist-tsc && node --loader ./tools/resolve-js-extension-loader.mjs dist-tsc/tests/AirScenario.report.js --fail-on-anomalies
